test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The hotel room, / which we / booked, / isn’t enough big.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect order of the adjectives and adverbs.
 
• In English, it is usually correct to say "big enough" rather than "enough big".
 
• The correct phrase should be "isn't big enough," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The hotel room, which we booked, isn’t big enough."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2: "which we,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "booked,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "The hotel room,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
